messages:
Priya: FYI NordicSupply just reported a customs reclass hold on our EU H100 shipment (7 units). ETA shift ~+18 days.
Tomas: Oof. Which customer pools are impacted?
Priya: Affected: eu-prod-pool (5), de-onprem-eval (2). Also 9 additional units in thermal QA at origin.
NordSupply: Confirmed. We can split: ship 5 by air expedite (premium ~EUR 2.9k/unit) and rest by sea. Need HS-code attestation + PO ref to push provisional AWBs.
Elena: Can vendor provide temporary refurb swaps for the critical hosts? We'd do 48h canary then handoff.
Priya: Reuse policy requires firmware parity; Ops will run a staged parity check.
Tomas: Cross-borrow from US spares is a fallback. Estimate: transit 5-7d + brokerage/VAT ~EUR 4.3k/unit all-in.
NordSupply: We can cover 40% of air premium if Redwood covers brokerage when mis-declaration is vendor fault. We'll include a refurb warranty addendum.
Procurement: PO ref PR-9112 ready. We'll send HS attestation once vendor confirms provisional AWBs.
ops-bot: Reminder: open incident if any tenant latency > SLO during replacement (/incidents/new).
Priya: Action items: Procurement send attestation by EOD; vendor to create AWBs within 24h; decide air-split vs cross-borrow by 12:00 UTC tomorrow. Reserve 3 US spares as hold until decision.
Elena: I'll draft firmware parity checklist and canary test steps (CANARY-778).
Tomas: I'll reserve spares and prep AMI + driver tweak notes.
NordSupply: AWB ticket will be created after docs. Tracking updates to follow.
Priya: Thanks team — keep updates here and tag SRE on incidents.
